/.title: OneGodian Everything App
/.headline: The operational launcher and dashboard layer for the OneGodian ecosystem.
/.body: app.OneGodian.com connects ODIN registry systems, planetary canon, moon systems, products, certificates, media tools, identity access, education bridges, verification, and synchronized platform infrastructure.

/dashboard.title: OneGodian App Dashboard
/dashboard.headline: Open real OneGodian member, contributor, creator, affiliate, certificate, product, media, learning, registry, tools, and settings modules.
/dashboard.body: The dashboard is the public/member-facing gateway for OneGodian identity, education, membership, tools, certificates, products, media, and ecosystem access.

/ecosystem.title: Ecosystem
/ecosystem.headline: See how app.onegodian.com, console.onegodian.com, capital.onegodian.com, onegodian.org, and onegodian.com work together.
/ecosystem.body: The app keeps .org identity/education/community/docs separate from .com commerce/products/services/payments and does not process contributions directly without a payment backend.

/omos.title: OMOS Runtime
/omos.headline: Connect the app to OMOS.OneGodian.com.
/omos.body: OMOS is the operating and protocol layer for identity-aware interaction, the OneGodian Algorithm, Belief Mapper logic, runtime processing, and structured AI-era systems. The app should read the OMOS manifest, display runtime health, and route authorized interactions to the OMOS node.

/registry.title: Registry
/registry.headline: Access OneGodian records, certificates, registry pathways, and ODIN references.
/registry.body: The registry organizes certificate references, identity records, public identifiers, verification links, and ODIN registry pathways for app-based lookup and navigation.

/tools.title: Tools
/tools.headline: Use OneGodian tools for reflection, records, and navigation.
/tools.body: Tools include Belief Mapper Lite, OneGodian Time conversion, ecosystem navigation, contributor intake, certificate lookup, and structured self-assessment utilities. Tools are voluntary and educational unless explicitly marked otherwise.

/members.title: OneGodian Membership
/members.headline: Membership CTA, pricing, resources, member certificates, member dashboard, and member support.
/members.body: Membership reflects the merged WordPress membership shortcodes for public and member-facing app access.

/certificates.title: Certificates
/certificates.headline: View and verify certificates, badges, and completion records.
/certificates.body: Certificates provide structured recognition for courses, membership, tools, contributor participation, and verified digital products. QRV integration should support public verification without exposing private account data.

/products.title: Products
/products.headline: Access OneGodian products, memberships, downloads, and learning resources.
/products.body: OneGodian.com remains the primary commerce and identity product infrastructure. The app should surface product categories, membership access, digital downloads, courses, founder products, and subscription pathways while routing checkout to the correct commerce system.

/media.title: Media
/media.headline: Use the media center for OneGodian platform content, education assets, campaigns, and public communication.
/media.body: The media area organizes videos, campaign assets, educational clips, founder updates, and shareable ecosystem media while keeping dashboards and commerce in their dedicated layers.

/settings.title: Settings
/settings.headline: Manage your profile, preferences, and app access.
/settings.body: Settings include account details, preferences, notification controls, privacy options, connected tools, membership display settings, and data export pathways where supported.

/docs.title: Documentation
/docs.headline: Read the operating documents behind the ecosystem.
/docs.body: Documentation includes OneGodian Algorithm references, OMOS integration notes, OneGodian Time standards, plugin guides, app routing rules, product documentation, and public-safe institutional explanations.

/store.title: Store Bridge
/store.headline: Connect to Onegodian.com products, services, downloads, certificates, and branded goods.
/store.body: The app provides store navigation and product-category access while checkout, purchases, and commercial fulfillment stay on Onegodian.com.

/learn.title: Learn
/learn.headline: Connect to guided materials, learning paths, Onegodianese™ resources, curriculum, and student portals.
/learn.body: Learning content is bridged from the app into public educational pages and u.Onegodian.org, the dedicated course and certification portal.

/identity.title: Identity
/identity.headline: Access member profile information, identity explanations, status, and participation records.
/identity.body: Identity resources explain the OneGodian framework, membership context, records, certificates, and voluntary participation pathways without implying governmental status or exemption from applicable law.

/verification.title: Verification
/verification.headline: View certificate tools, record references, verification pathways, and document lookup.
/verification.body: Verification tools help users locate references and records across the OneGodian app while keeping legal, commercial, and educational context clearly separated.

/capital.title: Capital
/capital.headline: Access capital tools, funding trackers, instruments, licensing, and business infrastructure.
/capital.body: Capital modules provide operational visibility for funding, instruments, valuation, licensing, and platform business infrastructure with appropriate disclosures.

/time.title: OneGodian Time
/time.headline: Use OneGodian Time tools as an internal presentation layer with Gregorian and UTC compatibility.
/time.body: OneGodian Time supports internal cultural and system chronology. Gregorian dates and UTC timestamps remain controlling for legal, financial, regulatory, contractual, and technical records.

/membership.title: Membership
/membership.headline: Explore member education, community participation, resources, and structured access.
/membership.body: Membership routes support voluntary participation, member education, profile records, community updates, certificates, and guided access within the OneGodian framework.

/contributors.title: Contributors
/contributors.headline: Contributors support ONEGODIAN, LLC public-facing products, education, media, technology, membership, and community infrastructure.
/contributors.body: Contribution tiers include Supporter $11, Builder $33, Sustainer $77, Founder Circle $111, Infrastructure Partner $333+, and Custom Contribution any amount. Contributions are voluntary support payments, not equity, securities, loans, bonds, investment contracts, or promises of financial return.

/creator-network.title: Creator Network
/creator-network.headline: Creators, affiliates, educators, and community voices can help share OneGodian identity, education, public resources, products, and campaigns.
/creator-network.body: The Creator Network provides a public application pathway and creator participation structure without activating payment, commission, or earnings logic in the app.

/affiliate-dashboard.title: Affiliate Dashboard
/affiliate-dashboard.headline: Referral links, campaign assets, contributor products, creator updates, compliance notice, and application status.
/affiliate-dashboard.body: The affiliate dashboard is a real placeholder structure only; no payment, commission, or earnings logic is active unless an approved backend exists.

/referral-links.title: Referral Links
/referral-links.headline: Referral link surface for creators and affiliates.
/referral-links.body: The app references [onegodian_referral_link] and can route approved users to future generated links without processing payments or commissions.

/contributor-wall.title: Contributor Wall
/contributor-wall.headline: Recognition surface for approved voluntary supporters.
/contributor-wall.body: The app references [onegodian_contributor_wall] and displays contributor recognition only when approved contributor data is available.

/learning.title: Learning
/learning.headline: Education bridge for identity, membership resources, documentation, and certificates.
/learning.body: Learning connects app users to OneGodian.org education, community documentation, membership resources, and member certificate context.

/framework.title: OMOS Framework
/framework.headline: The operating framework for OneGodian systems.
/framework.body: Framework documentation for interpretive, operational, interface, and compliance layers in OMOS Production Documentation Release 1.0.

/ohi.title: OHI Pipeline
/ohi.headline: From intake to monitored output.
/ohi.body: OHI pipeline documentation for intake, normalization, interpretation, routing, publication, and monitoring across OneGodian systems.
